Ah, this small plot of maize, only 0.29 hectares, and the land is not even mine — I rent it. At my age, 62 years, my back is not what it used to be, but maize is what feeds the family so I must do my best. I will try to put small fertilizer because the soil here in the South East is tired from too many seasons of planting, but money is tight so I cannot buy too much. I will use the seed I saved from last harvest like my mother taught me, and my children and grandchildren will help me with the work when school allows.
